name: Tomas Tobé - Après le § 53 - Am 42
title: REPORT on the findings and recommendations of the Special Committee on the European Democracy Shield
part_text: 53a. Stresses that EU institutions are themselves participants in the information environment through public communication, funding and awareness campaigns; emphasises that such activities and the funding of media and civil society must remain transparent and politically neutral and not be conditional on supporting the Commission’s contested policy preferences;
